pesanan_qris_menurut_metode.name: pesanan_qris_menurut_metode
pesanan_qris_menurut_metode.value: case when "pesanan"."metode" = 'QRIS' then "pesanan"."qris_id" is not null and "pesanan"."kedaluwarsa_pada" is not null and "pesanan"."gambar_qr" is not null else "pesanan"."qris_id" is null and "pesanan"."kedaluwarsa_pada" is null and "pesanan"."gambar_qr" is null and "pesanan"."kode_unik" = 0 end
